bizcity_journal_entries.purpose: Canonical user/team Journal authoring entries. KG sources are derived learning projections.

status.comment: journal-entry@1.1.0 state: captured/review/verified/failed/void (+ legacy draft/published/archived). failed = file not kept (Q121-13); verified only by a person (R-JN-14); void = removed from the register, row kept.

kind.comment: <family>.<type> (journal-kinds@1, docs/contracts/JOURNAL-KINDS-v1.json). Backfilled from source_type on upgrade; never empty after S100-L15.

doc_date.comment: The document's own date (meal day, contract date), not created_at.

tags.comment: Stored ',a,b,c,' so LIKE '%,tag,%' matches a whole tag.

find_text.comment: PHASE-0.133 (R-ENTRY-META EM-7): what can be searched about a row — title + about/summary + caption + OCR (≤ 4000) + keywords + topics + entities + people + visible card fields, as written and folded (no diacritics). Built by BizCity_Journal_Index from the row + metadata.meta; never sent by a caller. LIKE in v1 (FULLTEXT ngram later, Q133-M7).

meta_status.comment: PHASE-0.140 HOTFIX-META-INDEX: none = no entry-meta block, else metadata.meta.status (set = block without status). Derived by BizCity_Journal_Database::index_cols at every metadata write; '' = old row not backfilled yet.

has_file.comment: PHASE-0.140 HOTFIX-META-INDEX: 1 = metadata carries an attachment_id other than 0 (same meaning as the old LIKE filter). Derived like meta_status.

metadata.comment: journal-entry@1 card/confidence/original/subject/derived_from/flags/by (R-FILESTORE-BUSINESS query-requirement exception: query columns above, body here).

updated_at.type: DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
